Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Wash hands. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Crack eggs into bowl. Beat eggs. Pour into pan. Cook eggs. Turn off induction cooker. Place eggs on plate. Toast bread in toaster. Spread butter. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Stand up. Carry dishes to sink. Load dishwasher. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Press start. Wipe table. Turn off kitchen light.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk to office building. Enter building.

Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Log in. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open calendar. Check schedule. Attend meeting. Take notes. Make phone calls. Talk to colleagues. Write reports. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables, meat. Close refrigerator. Take out cutting board, knife, pan. Chop vegetables. Cut meat. Place pan on induction cooker. Turn on induction cooker. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Add seasoning. Turn off induction cooker. Place food on plate. Set table. Sit down. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Clear table. Load dishwasher. Start dishwasher. Wipe table. Turn off kitchen light.

Enter living room. Turn on TV. Pick up remote. Change channel. Sit on sofa. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Use phone. Get up. Get snack from kitchen. Return. Sit down. Continue watching. Turn off TV. Stand up.

Enter living room. Pick up book. Sit on sofa. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Adjust lamp. Read more. Place bookmark. Close book. Stand up. Stretch. Sit down. Pick up magazine. Flip pages.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down and preparing for sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on fan. Change into pajamas. Fold clothes. Place clothes in hamper. Set alarm on phone. Plug phone into charger. Turn off desk lamp. Lie on bed. Read book. Close book. Place book on nightstand. Turn off light. Close eyes.
Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Remain still. Breathe steadily. Sleep.
